text: Training moves through the fibres too, and the symmetry leaves a fingerprint. Under gradient flow, one quantity never changes: the balance between the two factors, B-transpose-B minus A-A-transpose, each divided by its own learning rate. It's a conserved charge, known for factorised networks since 2018, in the spirit of Noether's theorem. <short pause> With plain SGD steps, it drifts, but only at second order in the step size. Under Adam, it isn't conserved at all.
